items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: my younger brother Donald, when he was singing in a group, he had perfect pitch and so we could just play.

ctx.x: And were you ever in a position where you’re saying well we’ve been playing this vamp for eight minutes now, and I don’t know what to do with it anymore?

No. That’s the whole thing is I remember you have to — the thing is if you can get so you’re trying, every night, you’ve got to play certain songs anyway so you’ve got to try to approach the song, if you can, as if you’re playing it for the first time. If you can do that then that’s the key. You’re approaching the song for the first time and so it’s brand new, then you might try to find some different voicings and — but if you’ve got a very creative bass player and drummer and sometimes you use a guitarist,…
